name: Kedgeree
subtitle: smoked fish, rice and egg; the khichdi that went to England for breakfast

ingredients.qty: 400g smoked, or any firm fish plus 1/2 tsp smoked paprika

prepNotes: Kedgeree is khichdi rebuilt around smoked fish and eaten cold or warm at breakfast. It went home with returning families and stayed on British breakfast tables for a century.
Poach the fish in milk rather than water. It keeps the flesh soft and takes the edge off the smoke.

steps.text: Poach the fish gently in the milk with the bay leaf for 6 minutes. Lift out, flake coarsely and discard the milk and bones.
Boil the rice in salted water with the turmeric until just done. Drain and spread out to cool slightly.
steps.tip: Slightly undercook it. It gets stirred again.

steps.text: Fry the onion in the butter until soft and golden, 10 minutes.
Fold in the rice, then the flaked fish, keeping the pieces whole. Season with pepper.
steps.tip: Fold, do not stir. Stirring shreds the fish and breaks the grains.

steps.text: Top with the quartered eggs, scatter coriander, and finish with lemon.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. Cool it quickly and refrigerate within two hours, as with any cooked rice dish. Eat cold or reheat thoroughly.
